findings.body_feint: a repeatable SHAPE in 7/7: full tilt to one side of the running line (48–143°), held 50–121 ms, then across the line to the other side 167–250 ms after the start, held; route across varied (centre 2, back 1, front 4) — the signature is the side contradiction and its timing
findings.croqueta: 5/5 were the same contradiction, smaller (26–45°) and with a longer hold (67–250 ms); ranges meet the feint's; answer B (partially) — no croqueta-specific gesture: Croqueta as a contextual technique of the DECEPTION intent; never feasible in any owner attempt (run speed; right side = the left-footed twin's)
findings.ordinary: 8/8 sharp / gentle turns one-sided; angular velocity does not separate cuts from feints (1545 vs 1568 °/s); the side contradiction does
findings.physical_opportunity: fake L → exit R (8 gestures): requested at the onset 8/8 play (first stance +179–592 ms); at the recognition point 6/8 as played, 8/8 held (first stance 221–641 ms after recognition); the mirror never (right-footed player); the owner's own exits 67–82° outside the run band 35–40°

design: INTENT_RECOGNIZER_V1_DESIGN.md — vocabulary STEER (implicit) + DECEPTION L→R / R→L; recognition at the side contradiction (≈ 0.2 s); buffer ≤ one stride cycle via the existing explicit-request path; selector Body Feint / Croqueta (contextual) / ordinary; 5 owner decisions
